svg.aria-label: Major scale pattern W W H W W W H shown on a piano keyboard for C major, G major and F major
svg.text: W = whole step (2 semitones), H = half step (1 semitone). The pattern W W H W W W H never changes.
Numbers under the keys are scale degrees: 1 = tonic (I), 4 = subdominant (IV), 5 = dominant (V).
Red = the black key the pattern lands on (F♯ in G major, B♭ in F major). Arcs show each step.
